definitions.gloss: business closure, suspension of operations, shutdown
definitions.explanation: The temporary or indefinite cessation of business operations. Can refer to a planned day off, seasonal closure, or forced suspension.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}。
{臨時|りんじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}のお{知|し}らせ。
{台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{多|おお}くの{店|みせ}が{休業|きゅうぎょう}を{余儀|よぎ}なくされた。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, many shops were forced to close.

notes:
Commonly seen on signs and notices. In Japanese labor law, {休業|きゅうぎょう} also refers to official leave periods such as {育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう} (parental leave) and {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう} (nursing care leave).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休業|きゅうぎょう}する (to close, to suspend operations)
- {臨時|りんじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう} (temporary closure)
- {休業|きゅうぎょう}{日|び} (closure day)
- {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう} (parental leave)
- {休業|きゅうぎょう}{補償|ほしょう} (compensation during closure)
